positioning: Claude-compatible skill packs for Governance Systems Engineering workflows.

skills.name: change-governance-review
skills.description: Reviews change requests for governance completeness, CAB readiness, risk, rollback, validation, monitoring, approvals, and audit readiness.

skills.name: cab-readiness-check
skills.description: Determines whether a change request is ready for CAB review and decision-making.

skills.name: rca-governance-analysis
skills.description: Reviews RCA documentation for root cause quality, process gaps, monitoring gaps, ownership, corrective actions, and executive readiness.

skills.name: audit-evidence-request
skills.description: Converts audit evidence requests into evidence checklists, owner questions, response plans, and submission guidance.

skills.name: risk-register-builder
skills.description: Converts findings, issues, incidents, and observations into structured risk register entries.

skills.name: executive-grc-summary
skills.description: Creates concise executive-ready summaries for governance, risk, compliance, audit, change, RCA, and control updates.

skills.name: policy-exception-review
skills.description: Reviews policy exception requests for business justification, risk impact, compensating controls, approval requirements, expiration date, ownership, and audit-ready documentation. Use when evaluating exceptions to security, IT, compliance, access, change management, vendor, or data governance policies.

skills.name: third-party-risk-review
skills.description: Reviews vendors, SaaS tools, service providers, integrations, and third-party relationships for security, privacy, compliance, operational, data, and business risk. Use when assessing new vendors, renewals, questionnaires, SOC reports, DPAs, contracts, or application intake requests.

skills.name: control-evidence-quality-check
skills.description: Evaluates audit evidence for completeness, accuracy, traceability, date coverage, reviewer signoff, control relevance, and submission readiness. Use when reviewing SOC 2, ISO 27001, ITGC, access review, change management, incident, vendor, or policy evidence before submitting to auditors.

skills.name: governance-metrics-summary
skills.description: Turns operational governance data into leadership-ready metrics, trends, risks, exceptions, and action-oriented summaries. Use when summarizing CAB metrics, change volume, emergency changes, delayed closures, RCA actions, audit requests, evidence status, policy exceptions, or GRC program health.

skills.name: ai-governance-intake-review
skills.description: Reviews proposed AI tools, models, automations, copilots, data uses, and AI-assisted workflows for governance, risk, privacy, security, compliance, ownership, transparency, and approval readiness. Use when evaluating AI tool intake, AI vendor requests, internal AI workflow proposals, or AI risk reviews.
